items.title: The Product Rule of Probability (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: The Product Rule of Probability: a main subheading of 18.2.2 Inheritance and Mathematical Probabilities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 89-89.

blocks.text: Product rule kehta hai ke do ya zyada azad (independent) waqiyat ke aik saath hone ki probability un ki alag alag probabilities ko zarb (multiply) kar ke milti hai. Misaal: aik dice par chhakka aane ki probability 1/6 hai; do dice par dono chhakke aane ki probability (1/6) × (1/6) = 1/36 hai.
Product rule se fertilization ke nataij ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Misaal 1 (Aa × Aa)
blocks.problem: Aa × Aa se aa bachche ki probability kya hai?
steps: Har walid 1/2 probability se a wala gamete deta hai.
blocks.answer: Is liye aa bachche ki probability = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4.

blocks.title: Misaal 2 (RrYy × RrYy)
blocks.problem: RrYy × RrYy se gol peele bachche ki probability kya hai?
steps: Gol beej ki probability 3/4 aur peele beej ki probability 3/4 hai (har jora akela 3:1 deta hai).
blocks.answer: Is liye gol peele bachche ki probability = (3/4) × (3/4) = 9/16.
